semantics: n1..2500, k1..5; exactly 4n nonempty lowercase Latin lines, total length<=10000 (original English formatI: https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF138A?lang=en, 10^{4}). Rhyme is equality of suffixes beginning at the kth vowel from the end; too few vowels never rhyme. Intersect stanza schemes, returning aaaa only when every stanza is pairwise rhyming. Two different pair schemes imply aaaa, so the required output is unique. Linear suffix oracle independently checked by longest-common-suffix pair comparisons.
